name: E11 atom-instance compatibility and scope registry v1
semantics: All atom instances apply globally over the same declared scope. No segment-local reinterpretation is permitted.
compatibility_rule: A composition is compatible iff it includes no listed incompatible atom-instance pair and its clean-scope conjunction checker accepts it.
envelope_rule: Among compatible subsets of valid canonical atoms that contain the exact intended atom IDs, accept a task only if exactly one inclusion-maximal subset exists.
